title: Chat keeps what you type while reconnecting
summary: Typing in Chat right after opening or reloading the page is no longer interrupted when the room finishes reconnecting.
items: The message box used to be replaced the moment the room confirmed your session, so the cursor left it and letters typed at that instant were lost. A message typed then could leave Send greyed out.
The message box now stays in place and keeps focus, your draft and any message that is still sending.
